baseline_note: Current working files, including previous self-play optimization and publication display change.

selection.reason: Select eight games in eight processes with 2ms waiting, shared arrays, direct pipe notifications and persistent pinned buffers: lowest measured full-publication time among the three sequential cases.
selection.full_publication_confirmation: Both 32-game/0.5ms and 8-game/2ms optimized variants measured; select lower complete publication time.
selection.screen_selection_reason: 32 independent games in 8 processes, shared slots, direct pipe notifications, persistent pinned buffers. Selected by cheap screening and longer confirmation; 64 games and waits below 0.5ms rejected.

method: Same source learner/actor/replay copied independently into each case on D:. Reset only copied update schedule to initial total positions, requiring 4096 newly committed positions. 800 simulations per move, same architecture/precision/noise/temperature/SGD and microbatch. Normal pipeline with monitor on private port, identical performance collection, stop_after_publications=1. Wall time from pipeline initialization through first NEW actor export; excludes fixture copying and post-publication shutdown. Cases sequential; no concurrent benchmark workloads.
limitations: One complete publication per variant; not a confidence interval or steady-state average.
Parallel game count and BF16 batch scheduling may change trajectories and complete-game overshoot.
Cold startup, checkpoints and SGD included. Multi-version inference during sustained training can change batching.
GPU observations are sparse whole-device samples, not per-process kernel occupancy.

notes: Cumulative current-session rates; startup and unfinished searches are included in wall time
MCTS local CPU is a wall-time estimate, not process CPU time
Request RTT includes inference and queueing; it is not pure IPC overhead
Concurrent module times overlap and must not be added
P95 is a fixed-histogram approximate upper bound
CUDA events are sampled and read without additional synchronization
